ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 105
   D. 22

3. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 9

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 2

8. Solve for x: x + 9 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 9
   C. 9
   D. 8

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 49
   C. 41
   D. 43

15. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 32

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 22

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

18. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

20. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

21. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 72

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 25

24. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

25. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

26. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

27. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

28. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 12

29. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

30. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
